## Compatibility and handoff

- Engineering interfaces/schema impact:
- Remaining work or known risks:
- Design/teaching changes were not bundled into an engineering-only task.

Ordinary task PRs target dev and merge automatically only after the latest CI is fully green. Only a human merges dev into main, tags or publishes.
